cli.help.title: Unreal Agent Hub - a queue for shared resources of AI coding agents and scripts.
cli.help.status: who holds what, who waits, handover requests
cli.help.lock:
run a command while holding <res> (like flock); several are taken
in the order given ("cpp,cook": a packaging run holds both)
cli.help.hold: hold <res> for this chat until release / its agent exits / TTL
cli.help.release: release a hold of this chat (--force: anyone's)
cli.help.break: drop a stale lock (--force: also a live one; ask its owner first)
cli.help.claims: files claimed by chats (file gate); release frees one by hand
cli.help.watch: the project app (editor): state; down = closed by a chat, comes back
cli.help.grant: answer a handover request: "yes, take it"
cli.help.probe: what this machine is busy with (JSON)
cli.help.hook: hook entry point (stdin: the agent's hook JSON)
cli.help.nodeInstall: print the steps to set up a node
cli.help.duty: make this chat the hub's duty chat (notifications)
cli.help.resources:
Resources: an id ("cpp"), a project resource ("editor" inside a project with .unreal-agent-hub.json),
"@machine", "@node:<id>", or a pool "role:runner" (the first free runner wins).
cli.waiting: [hub] {key} is busy: {text}. Waiting{since} (--no-wait fails at once).
cli.freeOther: {key}: held by someone else now - left in place
cli.holdNeedsChat: a hold outlives this command: run it from an agent chat, or give --chat NAME and --ttl N.
cli.holdPresence: {key}: the person's presence lets this chat through
cli.holdDone: held {key} until `hub release {res}`, the end of this chat, or {ttl} min
cli.heldByOther: {key} is held by {holder}, not by this chat. --force releases it anyway; ask its owner first.
cli.watchNone: no `watch` settings for this folder (a profile or .unreal-agent-hub.json with watch.port)
cli.watchDown: {project}: marked as closed by a chat - calls wait for it and the board's watchdog starts it again when nothing holds {busy}
cli.breakLive: {key} is live: {what}. Only --force drops a live lock; ask its owner first. Nothing here stops processes.
cli.hereOn: presence on {key}{ttl}: remote runs queue and ask
cli.portTaken: port {port} is taken - the board is already running
cli.dutyNeedsChat: run `hub duty` from the chat that should receive the hub's notifications
cli.dutyDone: this chat ({id}) is the hub's duty chat now; handover requests and "machine is yours again" go here
cli.nodeAdded: node "{id}" is in {file}. On that machine, ~/.unreal-agent-hub/config.json:
cli.nodeNone: no node "{id}" - run hub node add {id} first
cli.nodeSteps.head: Steps for node "{id}" (nothing is run from here):
cli.nodeSteps.s1:
1. On {id}: install Node.js >= 18, then the plugin (Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add <owner>/unreal-agent-hub, /plugin install unreal-agent-hub),
   or the npm package: npm i -g unreal-agent-hub && hub install-hooks --agent claude
cli.nodeSteps.s2: 2. On {id}: write ~/.unreal-agent-hub/config.json as printed by `hub node add {id}` (role node, hubUrl, token).
cli.nodeSteps.s3: 3. Here: make sure `ssh {ssh} node .unreal-agent-hub/bin/hub.cjs probe` prints JSON (ssh keys are yours to set up).
cli.nodeSteps.s4: 4. Here: restart the board (hub serve); it opens the tunnel 127.0.0.1:{port} on {id}.
cli.doc.boardDown: is silent (hub serve starts it; hooks start it on demand)
cli.doc.nodeNoToken: - no token: any local process on the node can speak for it
cli.doc.shimMissing: - written on the first SessionStart or install-hooks
cli.doc.hooksOff: not installed (fine when the plugin is used)
status.none: No resources are configured yet (see docs/CONFIG.md).
notify.ask: {who} (from {from}) asks for {machine}: {what}. Answer "yes, take it" or "not now" on the board, or here (hub_grant / hub_decline).
notify.return: {who} finished on {machine} after {min} min - the machine is yours again{restored}.
gate.retry: Do other work and try again later; `hub status` shows the queue. Never stop processes you did not start.
gate.buildBusy: {rel}: "{key}" is busy - {holder}; waited {min} min. Edits of what the build compiles wait until the build is done. {retry}
gate.claimed: {rel} is being edited by chat "{chat}" (claimed {since}, last edit {last}); its changes are not committed yet. Two chats in one file overwrite each other, so this edit is refused. Ask that chat to make the change or to commit first. Freeing the claim by hand is for the person in charge: hub claims release "{rel}"
hook.appDown: {project}: the app is down and a restart is under way ({reason}); waited {min} min. Do other work and try again later; `hub watch` shows its state. Never stop processes you did not start.
hook.hubLine: Unreal Agent Hub: this machine ({label}) is the hub; board http://127.0.0.1:{port}. Heavy work of this {project} chat waits for shared resources by itself (a hook). Hold a resource across several steps with `hub hold <resource>` and free it with `hub release <resource>` (or the hub_hold / hub_release tools); `hub status` shows the queue. Never break or wait out someone else's lock by stopping their processes.
hook.held: Right now "{key}" is held by {holder}; work that needs it will wait.
hook.notice: Hub notification for the person (show it to them): {text}
nodeAgent.busy: This machine ({id}) is busy: {holder}. Waited {min} min. Do other work and try again later; never stop processes you did not start.
nodeAgent.start: Unreal Agent Hub: this machine ({id}) is a node of the hub on {hub}. Its machine resource is shared with the hub's runs: heavy work from this chat waits for it automatically, and remote runs wait while you or this chat use it.
nodeAgent.startNoHub: Unreal Agent Hub: this machine ({id}) is a node, but the hub is not reachable now; nothing waits for it until it is back.
nodeAgent.held: Right now this machine is held by {holder}{waiters}: do not launch the editor, the game or a build here until it is free (the hook waits on its own).
nodeAgent.asks: {n} remote run(s) ask for this machine; the person decides on the board ("Yes, take it" / "Not now").
install.statusMessage: Unreal Agent Hub: waiting for a shared resource
install.codexTrust: Codex runs new hooks only after you trust them: open Codex and run /hooks.
install.codexMcp:
MCP server (optional) - add to ~/.codex/config.toml:
[mcp_servers.unreal-agent-hub]
command = "node"
args = ["{shim}", "mcp"]
install.cursorWarn: Warning: {file} already has the hub's hooks, and Cursor runs those too. Remove one of the two.
presence.noResource: machine "{id}" has no machine resource (nodes[].resources, or machineResource for the hub)
presence.busy: busy: {holder} - the mark goes on when it is free
mcp.notHeld: Not held: {error}. Do other work and try again later; never stop processes you did not start.
mcp.holdPresence: {key}: the person's presence lets this chat through (nothing taken).
mcp.held: Held {key} (TTL {ttl} min). Release it with hub_release when done.
mcp.relNotMine: {key} is held by {holder}, not by this chat. Only its holder releases it.
mcp.noPending: No single pending handover request: name the resource or machine.
mcp.declined: Declined for now; it asks again in {min} min.
mcp.hubDown: The hub is not reachable from this node.
mcp.runsOnHub: {name} runs on the hub; on a node, heavy work holds this machine through the hook.
busy.grace: someone at {machine} closed their work {ago} min ago (a pause of {grace} min)
wait.breaking: a stale lock is being removed
err.lockLive: the lock is live: only `hub break --force` removes a live lock
ask.hideTip: Hide this request on this page. The run keeps waiting; the card comes back if it asks again.
ask.offline: No connection to the hub: the answer would not reach it
live.stale: No connection to the hub since {time}: the page shows what it knew then. It reconnects by itself.
